executive_summary: An elderly, frail woman stands hesitant at a snowy street crossing while crowds rush past. A young schoolboy steps out from his group of friends, gently guides her across, and explains to his peers that she is 'somebody's mother', hoping someone will help his own mother when she is old. That night, the woman prays for God's blessings upon the boy.
